It's genuinely a good game. You get many free daily pulls, and the reward events are plentiful. Outfits are a nice bonus, though styling isn't my focus.
First, the art is top-tier. Gameplay is classic boss-rushing. Many build choices—choose wisely. That’s all.
Blasing through the story is fun! Customizing Soul Core builds? Satisfying. Combat's intense. Minor flaws, but solid. Hope it improves!
Weirdly into this retro-dark art style. Story’s okay, but some mechanics demand skill.
Unique art style drew me in! Combat visuals are crisp and high-quality. Feedback is strong. Easy to play (I’m a newbie).
Story immersion is top-notch. Lore fans should play. Opening CG is worth watching. Environmental models, impress.
The opening CG told me this is a replay-worthy gem. Stunning animation—didn’t skip a single story bit.
Both the modeling and dark style are big pluses for me (Hela is so gorgeous!!!). After all, the overall presentation matters most in games. Secondly, gameplay that hooks you easily is a strength.
Gameplay variety is pretty high. Every boss makes me go "wow." Like Odin, fire giant man... Honestly didn't have super high expectations, but after playing properly, it's actually pretty good!

Positive reviews are likely fake due to in-game event encouraging players to write positive reviews for rewards. This game looks like a mash-up of store-bought assets and AI-generated content, with outfits that make zero sense in the context of the game world. It tries to be souls-like but it has god awful controls, clunky combat & non-existent combat feedback; key essential aspects that it absolutely fails at. Combined with the "get-strong-via gacha" style of gameplay, it makes the overall experience meaningless.

A gacha game that was ported to PC that has no clear visuals or mission length to justify being on here. If you want 5 minute long missions and gacha mechanics, this would be right up your alley. If not, there are other better gacha games to try with better combat and more missions variety.
